home.title: Manage loans and debts with FHE-guaranteed privacy
home.description: DebtRegistry combines Ethereum smart contracts and Fully Homomorphic Encryption to track debts, create protected repayments, and verify balances without exposing sensitive information. With NexusChat you can coordinate with counterparties securely and instantly.

1.title: 1. Sign in with Civic
1.description: Authenticate with Civic for fast and secure access.

2.title: 2. Register the debt
2.description: Enter amount, due date, and counterparty: the contract securely encrypts and stores data on-chain.

3.title: 3. Repay confidentially with Zama
3.description: Send confidential repayments thanks to Zama: only involved parties can decrypt the outstanding balance.

whatYouCanDo.title: What you can do
whatYouCanDo.1: • Declare a debt to any Ethereum address in a verifiable and encrypted way.
whatYouCanDo.2: • Share the outstanding balance only with authorized counterparties thanks to FHE decryption.
whatYouCanDo.3: • Update the debt with partial repayments while maintaining privacy on the actual value.

whyCivicZama.title: Why Civic + Zama
whyCivicZama.description: Civic authenticates the user's identity and ensures reliable sessions. Zama's Fully Homomorphic Encryption component enables a flow where the smart contract processes encrypted amounts, preventing third parties from reading sensitive data.
whyCivicZama.note: Once inside the Debt Registry your data will be safe, encrypted, and accessible only to you and authorized counterparties.

ready.title: Ready to get started?
ready.description: Sign in, connect your Civic wallet, and visit the Debt Registry to register your first encrypted debt.

debtRegistry.signInWithCivic: Sign in with Civic to use the FHE Debt Registry demo.
debtRegistry.connectWalletCivic: Connect your wallet through Civic to interact with the Debt Registry.
debtRegistry.title: FHE Debt Registry
debtRegistry.intro: Manage debts and repayments with verifiable transparency and end-to-end encrypted privacy. All actions go through your Civic wallet, with amounts handled by the contract only in homomorphic form.

newDebt.title: New debt
newDebt.description: Define a new debt relationship by specifying counterparties, amount, and due date. The amount is encrypted client-side before reaching the contract.

debtRegistry.confidentialTokenBalanceNote: The balance is stored encrypted on the contract. You can update and decrypt it at any time from the Civic wallet.
debtRegistry.approveSignatureToDecrypt: 🔐 Approve the signature in Civic to read the clear value.

manageDebt.title: Manage debt
manageDebt.description: Lookup an existing debt, send a confidential repayment, and request decryption of the outstanding balance.
